test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements is/are true about currency notes?

i. They do not have intrinsic value.

ii. They can be called fiat money.

iii. They are not legal tenders.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only i and ii.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

 
• Currency notes **do not **have **intrinsic value**, meaning they are **not valuable in** and of themselves, but rather are valuable because they are widely accepted as a **medium of exchange.**
